visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black tank top and grey-and-white patterned shorts, sits on a rustic wooden bench on the porch of a traditional Japanese house. She looks up with a serene expression, then turns to the camera, smiling and waving her right hand. The background shows wooden sliding doors and a lush green garden. (2) A wide shot captures the exterior of a traditional Japanese building with dark tiled roofs and brown wooden walls under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. A manicured pine tree stands tall in the foreground. (3) The camera pans across a meticulously maintained Japanese garden featuring moss-covered rocks, a small stone bridge, and various sculpted shrubs and trees. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the semi-transparent sliding glass doors of the house, which reflect the surrounding greenery and bright sky. (5) The woman is seen walking through a paved area of the garden next to vibrant pink flowers. She crouches down to admire the blooms, with a tall palm tree visible in the background against the clear sky. (6) A close-up shot features a white cat with grey patches lying on a mossy patch of ground. The cat rolls onto its back, stretches its paws playfully, and lets out a wide, long yawn, showing its teeth and tongue.
